display.purpose: Section headings, marketing display. Cormorant Garamond 600.

hero.purpose: Landing page hero only. Hard ceiling 86px.

body.purpose: All descriptive copy. DM Sans 400. Cap at 65–75ch.

label.purpose: Machine labels, field names. JetBrains Mono uppercase.

data.purpose: Live values: prices, percentages, regime codes.

shadows.name: nav-floating
shadows.purpose: Nav bar when scrolled; combined with backdrop-filter.

shadows.name: button-hover
shadows.purpose: Primary button on hover. Blue-matched glow.

shadows.name: input-focus
shadows.purpose: Input focus ring. Soft glow, not hard outline.

shadows.name: signal-dot-glow
shadows.purpose: Live data pulse indicators. Semantic green only.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Color, border, background transitions on hover/active.

motion.name: aurora
motion.purpose: Background blur orbs. Landing page only; never in product UI.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA. Used for Access Sentinel, Run Pipeline, Submit actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #4f83ff; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 28px; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.2s, transform 0.18s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #7aa3ff; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 26px rgba(79,131,255,0.45); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(79,131,255,0.30); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action. Paired with Primary Button for two-CTA rows.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: #7a8baa; padding: 12px 28px; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; border: 1px solid rgba(99,132,255,0.20); border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { color: #4f83ff; border-color: #4f83ff; background: rgba(37,99,235,0.06); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(79,131,255,0.15); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Top navigation link. Active state uses surface-raised pill.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #7a8baa; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 6px; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s, background 0.2s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #e8eeff; } .ds-nav-link--active { color: #e8eeff; background: #111d38; }

components.name: Data Chip
components.description: Regime driver labels, key signal pills, filter tags.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #7a8baa; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(99,132,255,0.20); background: rgba(79,131,255,0.05); transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: rgba(99,132,255,0.35); background: rgba(79,131,255,0.10); }

components.name: Dashboard Card
components.description: Primary container for regime data, flow data, scenario panels.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #080d1c; border-radius: 14px; padding: 30px 26px; box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), 0 0 0 1px rgba(79,131,255,0.06); transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-card:hover { background: #111d38; } .ds-card-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.22em; color: #2e3d58; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-size: 27px; font-weight: 600; color: #e8eeff; line-height: 1.2; }

components.name: Signal Indicator
components.description: Equity bias / conviction / RBI signal value. Color is semantic only.
components.css: .ds-signal { padding: 8px 0; } .ds-signal-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.18em; color: #2e3d58; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-signal-value { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; } .ds-signal-value--green { color: #10d48a; } .ds-signal-value--amber { color: #fbbf24; } .ds-signal-value--red { color: #f87171; } .ds-signal-value--blue { color: #4f83ff; } .ds-signal-value--neutral { color: #7a8baa; }

components.name: Confidence Bar
components.description: Regime confidence percentage bar. Always Signal Blue fill.
components.css: .ds-conf-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-conf-bar-wrap { flex: 1; height: 3px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-conf-bar { height: 100%; border-radius: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #4f83ff, #6366f1); transition: width 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(79,131,255,0.5); } .ds-conf-pct { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: #4f83ff; min-width: 40px; text-align: right; }

narrative.overview:
EconIq is a precision instrument for professionals who read data for a living. The interface behaves like a sealed intelligence room: dark, focused, and organized. Every element has a specific job. Nothing decorates; everything informs. The visual density is controlled — data-rich without feeling cluttered — because the audience are advisors who need a defensible answer in 30 seconds, not analysts who enjoy data exploration for its own sake.

The palette is a near-black navy anchored in Midnight Vault with a blue-tinted depth progression across four surface levels. Color appears only when it carries signal: green for positive regime conditions, amber for caution, red for stress, blue for primary actions and active state. Monospace type handles all live data values, percentages, labels, and regime codes. Cormorant Garamond serif provides institutional weight for headings; DM Sans delivers clean body copy.

The system explicitly rejects: consumer fintech (Zerodha/Groww), generic AI-SaaS cream, news/media noise, and the dense legacy terminal look.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first, data-forward: dark mode is canonical; light mode mirrors the same token structure
Two-font system: serif for authority, mono for data, sans for clarity — never crossed
Signal colors carry information, never decoration
Monochrome-adjacent surfaces with controlled accent saturation
Institutional tone: no marketing flair in the product UI, no consumer patterns in either surface

rules.name: The Signal Color Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, red, and gold appear only when a data value warrants them. Never use these colors for decoration, background tints on non-signal elements, or marketing emphasis.

rules.name: The Blue Discipline Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue (#4f83ff) is the only accent on any given screen. Indigo and violet exist only inside gradient expressions. On product surfaces: no gradient text, no violet standalone.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Machine Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is reserved for data output and labels — items the engine generates. Narrative copy is always DM Sans.

rules.name: The Serif Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Cormorant Garamond headings stop at 86px (clamp max). Above that the page is announcing, not informing.

rules.name: The No-Ambient-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Static surfaces carry no drop shadow. Depth is communicated through the background progression and 1px ring. Shadows appear only in response to state (hover, floating, focus).

dos: Do use Cormorant Garamond exclusively for headings (Display / Title hierarchy). Serif body text is prohibited.
Do use JetBrains Mono for all machine-generated values: percentages, prices, regime codes, dates, tickers, label text.
Do apply semantic signal colors (green/amber/red) only when a data value warrants the color.
Do express card depth through the background progression and the 1px blue border ring.
Do maintain backdrop-filter: blur(24px) exclusively on the nav.
Do provide @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) fallbacks on every animation.
Do use text-wrap: balance on all Display and Title headings.
Do verify contrast on monospace label text at 9–11px — highest-risk surface in both themes.
donts: Don't use retail fintech patterns (Zerodha/Groww aesthetic): color saturation on navigation, progress-bar reward loops, emoji-heavy copy.
Don't use the generic AI-SaaS cream aesthetic: warm near-white backgrounds, purple-to-blue gradient CTAs, identical icon+heading+text card grids.
Don't use background-clip: text gradient text. Gradient text is an absolute ban across both surfaces.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards or list items.
Don't apply box-shadow to static resting cards. Shadows communicate state change (hover, floating).
Don't nest cards. Use a divider, data row, or background-shift instead.
Don't introduce a fourth typeface. The three-family system is complete.
Don't use Text Ghost (#2e3d58) for body copy — it fails 4.5:1 contrast on Surface Deep.
